q: What is the underlying margin by business unit in the FY2027 BU plan?

r.narrative: In the FY2027 BU plan the group underlying margin is **9.6%** (GBP 365M on GBP 3.80B), above the 9% floor. **Bupa Global** has the highest margin at 12.5%, **UK Insurance** contributes the most profit (GBP 191M at 9.5%), and **Care Services** is lowest at 7.0% with agency staffing as the main drag.
r.sql:
SELECT DIM_SECONDARY AS business_unit,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ACCOUNT_CODE IN ('rev-gross','rev-ded') THEN AMOUNT END) AS revenue,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ACCOUNT_CODE IN ('rev-gross','rev-ded') THEN AMOUNT
                WHEN ACCOUNT_CODE IN ('cogs-mat','cogs-lab','cogs-oh','opex-sm','opex-rd','opex-ga','da-plants','da-facilities','da-tech') THEN -AMOUNT END) AS underlying_profit
FROM SDP_BUPA.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_ENTRY
WHERE VERSION_ID = 2  -- FY2027 BU Plan
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC;

q: Show FY2027 revenue growth by business unit versus the FY2026 forecast

r.narrative: FY2027 BU plan revenue is **GBP 3.80B**, up **6.3%** on the FY2026 Q3 forecast of GBP 3.58B. **Clinics & Hospitals** grows fastest (+13.3%) as King Edward VII and New Victoria hospitals ramp up, followed by **Bupa Global** (+7.6%) and **UK Insurance** (+5.7%). The plan is GBP 50M short of the GBP 3.85B ambition.
r.sql:
SELECT e.DIM_SECONDARY AS business_unit,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.VERSION_ID = 3 THEN e.AMOUNT END) AS fy26_forecast,
       SUM(CASE WHEN e.VERSION_ID = 2 THEN e.AMOUNT END) AS fy27_plan
FROM SDP_BUPA.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_ENTRY e
JOIN SDP_BUPA.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_VERSION v ON e.VERSION_ID = v.VERSION_ID
WHERE e.ACCOUNT_CODE IN ('rev-gross', 'rev-ded')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY (fy27_plan - fy26_forecast) / NULLIF(fy26_forecast, 0) DESC;

q: Which claims pathway is growing fastest in the cost of care?

r.narrative: Blended medical inflation is **6.8%** in the FY2027 plan model. **Mental health** claims cost is growing fastest at 11.5%, followed by **cancer care** at 9.2% — longer treatment courses and new therapies. **Musculoskeletal** claims are only 3.2% as members move to direct-access physiotherapy and digital rehab.
r.sql:
SELECT ACCOUNT_CODE, PERIOD, SUM(AMOUNT) AS claims_cost
FROM SDP_BUPA.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_ENTRY
WHERE ACCOUNT_CODE = 'cogs-mat'  -- Claims incurred & medical costs
  AND VERSION_ID IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2;

q: What is the agency staffing gap against target by care home region?

r.narrative: Agency staffing runs at **11.8%** of clinical hours against a **9%** target (model). The gap is widest in **North** care homes (13.9%) and the **Midlands & East** (12.6%). Converting 120 agency carer roles to permanent contracts in those two regions closes most of the gap and removes the agency premium.
r.sql:
SELECT DIM_SECONDARY AS business_unit, PERIOD, SUM(AMOUNT) AS clinical_workforce_cost
FROM SDP_BUPA.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_ENTRY
WHERE ACCOUNT_CODE = 'cogs-lab'  -- Clinical & care workforce
  AND DIM_SECONDARY = 'Care Services' AND VERSION_ID = 2
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 2;

q: Compare average premium per member across UK Insurance service lines

r.narrative: UK Insurance covers about **2.3m members** (in line with Bupa's published UK Insurance customer base). In the FY2027 plan model, **Individual PMI** has the highest average premium at GBP 110 per member-month, **Corporate PMI** averages GBP 71.80 across 1.45m members, and **Health Cash Plans** average GBP 30.70.
r.sql:
SELECT DIM_TERTIARY AS service_line, SUM(AMOUNT) AS revenue
FROM SDP_BUPA.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_ENTRY
WHERE DIM_SECONDARY = 'UK Insurance'
  AND ACCOUNT_CODE IN ('rev-gross', 'rev-ded') AND VERSION_ID = 2
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC;

q: What is the capex plan versus depreciation by programme?

r.narrative: The FY2027 capex plan is **GBP 245M**, inside the GBP 250M envelope, against depreciation of about **GBP 104M**. **Hospitals & clinics** is the largest programme (GBP 70M) — diagnostics, theatres and new sites — followed by **care home refurbishment and fire safety** (GBP 55M) and **dental practice expansion** (GBP 45M). Investment is self-funded from operating cash flow.
r.sql:
SELECT ACCOUNT_CODE, SUM(AMOUNT) AS amount
FROM SDP_BUPA.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_ENTRY
WHERE ACCOUNT_CODE IN ('cf-capex', 'da-plants', 'da-facilities', 'da-tech')
  AND VERSION_ID = 2  -- FY2027 BU Plan
GROUP BY 1;
